title: JANUS Linear A SigLA technical interface probe specification
purpose: Discover and freeze the public SigLA document-page interface contract needed for a later content-level adapter without selecting documents by transcription content or scientific interest.

sample_selection.universe: the 686 collision-free bridge keys reconstructible from the frozen SigLA browse snapshot and frozen mwenge inventory
sample_selection.score: SHA256(namespace + '|' + bridge_key) interpreted lexicographically as lowercase hexadecimal
sample_selection.selection: three bridge keys with the lexicographically smallest hash scores

predeclared_interface_observables: HTTP status, Content-Type, byte length and SHA-256
all anchor hrefs and normalized anchor text
all element attributes whose names start with data-
all href/action/src values containing case-insensitive word, json, data, api, document, sign or index
presence/count of visible text markers 'word view', 'sign view', 'signs', 'words'
HTML snapshots for all three pages
forbidden_interpretations: do not compare sign values across sources
do not compare word segmentation across sources
do not infer a JSON endpoint from a filename pattern not observed in HTML
do not infer a word-view route from human expectation if no link/action is observed
do not treat interface agreement as transcription agreement
do not promote any document/sign/word candidate
next_if_successful: Freeze a SigLA source-adapter contract based only on interface elements observed consistently or explicitly documented by SigLA, then create a separate R3A-3 content sampling spec.
